data.message:
fix(fault_manager): #155 use wall clock time instead of simulation time

When running with use_sim_time=true, fault timestamps were recorded
in simulation time (seconds since sim start) instead of wall clock time.
This caused incorrect timestamps like "1970-01-01" when UI interpreted
simulation time as Unix epoch.

Changes:
- Add time_utils.hpp with get_wall_clock_ns() and get_wall_clock_time()
- Replace node->now() with wall clock utilities for fault timestamps in:
  - FaultManagerNode: report_fault_event, publish_fault_event, auto-confirm
  - SnapshotCapture: on-demand and background cache timestamps
  - RosbagCapture: message timestamps and bag metadata
- Add unit test to verify timestamps are valid wall clock values

data.author: mfaferek93
data.message:
fix(gateway): allow slashes in configuration parameter IDs

  ROS2 parameters like qos_overrides./parameter_events.publisher.depth
  contain slashes in their names. cpp-httplib decodes percent-encoded
  URLs (%2F -> /), so the route regex must use (.+) instead of ([^/]+)
  to match the full parameter name.

  This is consistent with the existing pattern for topic routes.

data.author: mfaferek93
data.message:
fix(gateway): #153 serialize parameter operations to prevent executor conflicts

  SyncParametersClient internally spins param_node_ via spin_node_until_future_complete(),
  which is not thread-safe. Concurrent HTTP requests would cause:
  "Node '/_param_client_node' has already been added to an executor"

  Add mutex to serialize all parameter operations (list, get, set, reset).
  Add regression test with warm-up to prevent flaky CI failures.

data.author: mfaferek93
data.message:
fix(fault_manager): allow CLEARED faults to be reactivated by FAILED events

  Previously, report_fault_event() had an early return that silently
  ignored all events for CLEARED faults. This caused faults to remain
  CLEARED forever even when the underlying issue recurred.

  Changes:
  - FAILED events now reactivate CLEARED faults with debounce counter
    reset to -1 (fresh start)
  - PASSED events for CLEARED faults are still ignored (expected)
  - occurrence_count increments on reactivation
  - Return true to trigger EVENT_CONFIRMED and snapshot capture

  Updated tests to reflect new behavior and added integration test.

Implement hierarchical and auto-cluster correlation modes to reduce
fault noise by identifying root causes and grouping related faults.

Key features:
- Hierarchical mode: detect root cause → symptom relationships
- Auto-cluster mode: group similar faults within time window
- YAML-based configuration with pattern wildcards
- Muted faults tracking and auto-clear on root cause resolution

  - R001: Version must be '1.0'
  - R002-R005: Unique IDs for all entity types
  - R006: Valid area/parent references
  - R007: App must reference existing component
  - R008: depends_on references validation (warning)
  - R009: hosts references validation (warning)
  - R010: No duplicate ROS bindings
  - R011: Circular dependency detection
- Add Manifest, ManifestConfig, ManifestMetadata structs

Add ManifestManager class for thread-safe manifest loading, validation,
and entity access:
- load_manifest(path, strict) / load_manifest_from_string(yaml, strict)
- reload_manifest() / unload_manifest() for lifecycle management
- Entity access: get_areas(), get_components(), get_apps(), get_functions()
- O(1) lookup by ID via index maps
- Relationship queries: get_components_for_area(), get_apps_for_component(),
  get_hosts_for_function(), get_subareas(), get_subcomponents()
- get_status_json() for REST API integration
- Thread-safe with std::mutex protection

* feat(discovery): add RuntimeLinker for manifest-to-runtime binding

Implement RuntimeLinker class that binds manifest-declared Apps to actual
ROS 2 nodes discovered at runtime:

- Exact match: node_name + namespace both match
- Wildcard namespace: namespace='*' matches any namespace
- Topic namespace: topic_namespace prefix matches node's topics
- Enriches linked apps with runtime data (topics, services, actions)
- Detects orphan nodes (runtime nodes not in manifest)
- Applies orphan policy: ignore/warn/error/include_as_orphan
- Provides lookup methods: is_app_online(), get_bound_node(), get_app_for_node()

Implement discovery mode configuration for DiscoveryManager:

DiscoveryManager now supports:
- Entity lookup by ID: get_area(), get_component(), get_app(), get_function()
- Relationship queries: get_subareas(), get_subcomponents(),
  get_components_for_area(), get_apps_for_component(), get_hosts_for_function()
- Manifest management: get_manifest_manager(), reload_manifest()
- Mode switching with fallback to runtime on manifest load failure

HybridDiscoveryStrategy features:
- Uses manifest as source of truth for entity IDs
- Links Apps to runtime nodes via RuntimeLinker
- Enriches manifest components with runtime topics/services/actions
- Handles orphan nodes per ManifestConfig policy

feat(#82): add SSE endpoint for real-time fault event streaming (#115)

* feat(#82): add SSE endpoint for real-time fault event streaming

Add Server-Sent Events (SSE) endpoint at GET /api/v1/faults/stream
for real-time fault notifications.

Features:
- FaultManager publishes FaultEvent messages on ~/events topic
- Gateway subscribes and streams events to HTTP clients
- Multi-client support with thread-safe event queue
- Keepalive every 30s to prevent connection timeout
- Last-Event-ID header support for reconnection
- Buffer of 100 events for missed event replay

* test(#82): add unit tests for FaultEvent publishing

Add FaultEventPublishingTest fixture with 6 new tests:
- NewFaultPublishesConfirmedEvent
- UpdateExistingFaultPublishesUpdatedEvent
- ClearFaultPublishesClearedEvent
- ClearNonExistentFaultNoEvent
- EventContainsCorrectTimestamp
- EventContainsFullFaultData

Tests verify that FaultManagerNode correctly publishes events
to the ~/events topic when faults are reported, updated, or cleared.

* fix(#82): address code review feedback for SSE implementation

- Reuse FaultManager::fault_to_json() instead of duplicate in SSEFaultHandler
  (made FaultManager::fault_to_json static and public)
- Add sse.max_clients parameter (default 10) to limit concurrent SSE connections
  and prevent resource exhaustion attacks
- Return 503 Service Unavailable when client limit is reached
- Document SSE endpoint and sse.max_clients parameter in README.md

Code improvements:

data.author: Michal Faferek
data.message:
feat(#80): add count-based fault confirmation threshold (#100)

* feat(#80): add count-based fault confirmation threshold

  Implement automatic PENDING → CONFIRMED transition when a fault reaches
  the configured occurrence count threshold.

  Changes:
  - Add  parameter to FaultManagerNode (default: 3)
  - Implement auto-confirmation logic in InMemoryFaultStorage and SqliteFaultStorage
  - Faults transition to CONFIRMED when occurrence_count >= threshold
  - Setting threshold to 0 disables auto-confirmation (faults stay PENDING)
  - GetFaults returns only CONFIRMED faults by default

  Configuration example:
    fault_manager:
      confirmation_threshold: 3  # 0 = disabled

* feat(#80): add FAILED/PASSED event model to fault reporting

- ReportFault.srv: Add event_type field (EVENT_FAILED=0, EVENT_PASSED=1)
  - FAILED: fault condition detected, decrements debounce counter
  - PASSED: fault condition cleared, increments debounce counter
  - Change response to simple 'accepted' bool

- Fault.msg: Add debounce-based status lifecycle
  - PREFAILED: counter < 0, trending towards confirmation
  - PREPASSED: counter > 0, trending towards healing
  - CONFIRMED: counter <= threshold, fault verified
  - HEALED: counter >= healing_threshold, fault resolved
  - CLEARED: manually acknowledged

* feat(#80): implement debounce filtering with FAILED/PASSED event model

- Add DebounceConfig struct with configurable thresholds:
  - confirmation_threshold (default: -3, 3 FAILED events to confirm)
  - healing_enabled/healing_threshold (default: disabled, +3 to heal)
  - critical_immediate_confirm (default: true, CRITICAL bypasses debounce)
  - auto_confirm_after_sec (default: 0, time-based confirmation)

- Update FaultStorage interface:
  - Replace report_fault() with report_fault_event(event_type, ...)
  - Replace set/get_confirmation_threshold with set/get_debounce_config
  - Add check_time_based_confirmation() method

- Implement debounce logic in InMemoryFaultStorage and SqliteFaultStorage:
  - FAILED events decrement counter, PASSED events increment counter
  - Status transitions: PREFAILED -> CONFIRMED (counter <= threshold)
  - Status transitions: PREPASSED -> HEALED (counter >= healing threshold)
  - CRITICAL severity bypasses debounce and confirms immediately
  - CLEARED faults ignore subsequent events

- Update FaultManagerNode to use new interface

- Add comprehensive unit tests for both storage backends

- Update integration tests for new event model

* feat(#80): update fault_reporter library for FAILED/PASSED event model

- Add report_passed() method to report PASSED events
- Update send_report() to include event_type in requests
- PASSED events bypass local filtering (always forwarded)
- Update integration tests for new response.accepted interface

* docs(#80): update READMEs for debounce filtering model

- Document FAILED/PASSED event model in fault_manager README
- Add debounce model diagram and lifecycle explanation
- Add confirmation_threshold parameter documentation
- Update manual testing examples with event_type
- Document report_passed() method in fault_reporter README
- Update usage example to show PASSED event reporting

* fix(#80): update gateway and Postman for new fault status model

- Replace STATUS_PENDING with STATUS_PREFAILED in gateway
- Update report_fault() to use event_type and response.accepted
- Rename include_pending to include_prefailed parameter
- Update Postman collection descriptions for new statuses

* fix(#80): update remaining PENDING references to PREFAILED

- Update GetFaults.srv comments for new status values
- Update rest_server.cpp query param from 'pending' to 'prefailed'
- Update ros2_medkit_msgs README with debounce model documentation

* fix(#80): update all documentation for debounce model

- Update FaultEvent.msg comment (PENDING → PREFAILED)
- Update ros2_medkit_msgs README FaultEvent table
- Update design/index.rst with debounce lifecycle model
- Update service descriptions for event_type and accepted response

* style: fix clang-format issues in fault_manager and gateway

* fix(#80): address Copilot review comments for debounce model

- Fix HEALED status comment in Fault.msg (was incorrectly saying "removed from storage")
- Fix DebounceConfig threshold==0 comment to clarify immediate confirmation behavior
- Add debounce counter saturation checks to prevent integer overflow/underflow
  in both InMemoryFaultStorage and SqliteFaultStorage
- Add migration error logging with expected error filtering in SqliteFaultStorage
- Add "Status Persistence" section in README clarifying HEALED/CLEARED retention
- Add "Current Limitations" section documenting unimplemented features

* feat(#80): expose healing and auto-confirm parameters in FaultManagerNode

- Add `healing_enabled` parameter (bool, default: false)
- Add `healing_threshold` parameter (int, default: 3)
- Add `auto_confirm_after_sec` parameter (double, default: 0.0)
- Create periodic timer for time-based auto-confirmation when enabled
- Update README with new parameters documentation
- Remove "Current Limitations" section (features now implemented)
- Add unit tests for new parameters

* refactor(#80): address additional Copilot review comments

- Clarify threshold documentation (any value >= -1 gives immediate confirmation)
- Remove redundant threshold==0 check in InMemoryFaultStorage, use update_status()
- Remove redundant threshold==0 check in SqliteFaultStorage, use explicit logic
- Improve migration error handling to handle NULL error messages from SQLite

* fix(#80): fix documentation and remove dead code

- Fix HEALED status in lifecycle diagrams (Fault.msg and README)
  Changed "(removed)" to "(retained)" to match actual behavior
- Remove unused update_status_in_db method from SqliteFaultStorage
  The status update logic is already inline in report_fault_event

* refactor(#80): code quality improvements

- Expand comment about counter==0 hysteresis behavior in update_status()
- Remove unnecessary defensive free in SQLite migration code
- Add test: ConfirmedFaultCanHealWithPassedEvents
- Add test: HealedFaultCanRecurWithFailedEvents

* feat(fault_manager): change default confirmation_threshold to -1 for immediate confirmation

Faults are now immediately confirmed on first report (no debounce by default).
This simplifies the default user experience - just call report() and the
fault is confirmed. Advanced users who need debounce filtering can set
confirmation_threshold to lower values (e.g., -3).

Changes:
- Default confirmation_threshold: -3 → -1 in DebounceConfig and FaultManagerNode
- Updated fault_manager README with "Quick Start" section (simple first)
- Updated fault_reporter README with simplified examples
- Updated unit tests to explicitly set threshold for debounce testing
- Integration tests use confirmation_threshold=-3 for lifecycle testing

data.author: Bartosz Burda
data.message:
feat(gateway): add JWT authentication with RBAC

Implement comprehensive authentication and authorization system for the
ros2_medkit gateway using JSON Web Tokens (JWT) with Role-Based Access
Control (RBAC).

Features:
- OAuth2 client_credentials flow for authentication
- JWT tokens with HS256/RS256 signing algorithms
- Refresh token support with revocation capability
- Four-tier RBAC: viewer, operator, configurator, admin
- Configurable auth requirements (none/write/all)
- Pre-routing middleware for endpoint protection

New endpoints:
- POST /api/v1/auth/authorize - Client authentication
- POST /api/v1/auth/token - Token refresh
- POST /api/v1/auth/revoke - Token revocation

Dependencies:
- jwt-cpp v0.7.0 (fetched via CMake FetchContent)
- OpenSSL (system package)

Auth is disabled by default for backward compatibility.
Enable via `auth.enabled: true` in gateway_params.yaml.

data.message:
#97 feat(gateway): add GET /api/v1/faults endpoint for system-wide fa… (#98)

* fix(devcontainer): add --network=host for ROS 2 DDS discovery

   Enable host network mode in devcontainer to allow proper ROS 2 DDS
   discovery with external systems like NVIDIA Isaac Sim.

   This is required because:
   - ROS 2 uses multicast for node discovery (DDS)
   - Docker bridge network isolates multicast traffic
   - Isaac Sim runs on the host and publishes ROS 2 topics
   - Without host networking, topics from Isaac Sim are not visible

* fix(fault_manager): include PENDING faults in default get_faults filter

  Previously get_faults() only returned CONFIRMED faults by default,

data.author: Michal Faferek
data.message:
fix(devcontainer): add --network=host for ROS 2 DDS discovery

   Enable host network mode in devcontainer to allow proper ROS 2 DDS
   discovery with external systems like NVIDIA Isaac Sim.

   This is required because:
   - ROS 2 uses multicast for node discovery (DDS)
   - Docker bridge network isolates multicast traffic
   - Isaac Sim runs on the host and publishes ROS 2 topics
   - Without host networking, topics from Isaac Sim are not visible

(INFO/WARN/ERROR/CRITICAL), status lifecycle (PENDING/CONFIRMED/CLEARED),
multi-source tracking via reporting_sources array, and occurrence counting

event types (fault_confirmed/cleared/updated)

and ros2_medkit_fault_reporter packages.

many topics are idle (e.g., waiting for navigation commands).
